mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing tetrabenazine plasma concentrations and its active metabolites, while both agents may have additive effects on dopamine antagonism and CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased tetrabenazine adverse effects (tardive dyskinesia, parkinsonism, sedation); consider dose reduction if concurrent use is necessary; counsel patient on potential additive CNS effects.
